title: What they say when they feel insecure
hook: Not what it sounds like. Read it again.
end_sub: Say it properly. Comment the number.
items: Nice of you to show up.
I waited all evening and I missed you.
I'm struggling and I feel you don't see it.
I need a lot. I'm scared to ask.
I feel far away from you lately. Reassure me.
Please worry about me a little.
